title: Frost on the Pond
note: b383 — first real use of the b383 'sprawl' and 'spin' poses, which were added specifically for this book's comic slips and spins. No dedicated frozen-pond ground exists, so the frozen surface is 'pond_day' plus scattered 'frost' crystal props across it.

pages.brief: Wide winter morning: the pond frozen and white, reeds stiff with frost, everything blue and silver. Beautiful and very cold.
pages.alt: A wide winter morning view of the pond, frozen and white, with reeds stiff with frost in blue and silver light.

pages.brief: Ned stepping onto the ice with one foot, other foot still on the bank, an expression of doubt. The instant before it goes wrong.
pages.alt: Ned steps onto the ice with one foot, his other foot still on the bank, an expression of doubt on his face — the instant before it all goes wrong.

pages.brief: Ned flat on his front on the ice, legs splayed in all four directions, beak on the frost. Seen from directly above. Extremely funny — drawn wide and flat on purpose, not tall; the top-down angle is the joke.
pages.alt: Ned lies completely flat on the ice, legs splayed in every direction and his beak right on the frost.

pages.brief: Ned sliding helplessly across the whole width of the page still lying flat, with a look of resignation. Long horizontal composition — deliberately wide and flat, not tall.
pages.alt: Ned slides helplessly across the whole width of the frozen pond, still lying flat, with a look of complete resignation.

pages.brief: Moss bursting out of his leaf pile den at the bank, spikes bristling, at full hedgehog speed (which is not fast).
pages.alt: Moss bursts out of his leaf-pile den at the bank, spikes bristling, going at full hedgehog speed, which is not very fast at all.

pages.brief: Moss at the ice edge with one paw out, shouting; Ned still on his back some distance away, waving one foot. Comic distance between them.
pages.alt: Moss stands at the ice edge with one paw out, shouting, while Ned lies on his back some distance away, waving one foot.

pages.brief: Ned spinning on the ice like a top, wings out, blurred, delighted. Circular motion lines and a happy face in the middle.
pages.alt: Ned spins on the ice like a top, wings flung out, delighted, with circular motion lines swirling around him.

pages.brief: Both of them on the ice now, Moss sliding on his tummy, Ned spinning, ice shavings flying. Full of joy and movement.
pages.alt: Moss slides on his tummy and Ned spins beside him, both on the ice, ice shavings flying, full of joy and movement.

pages.brief: Closing page: the two of them heading back into the leaf den at dusk, frost on their backs, warm dark hole ahead of them.
pages.alt: Closing page: Ned and Moss head back into the warm, dark leaf den at dusk, frost still on their backs.
